csv_project_name: AE for Calispel Valley & Ione Libraries Remodel
csv_scope_of_work: The District intends to remodel two existing libraries in Cusick and Ione, WA. The selected architect will be required to perform the basic architectural and engineering services, to be specified more fully in a contract agreement to be negotiated after selection. The scope of work will include reasonable and customary development of construction documents, construction administration, and project closeout activities as generally described in the AIA A201 family of documents.

title: AE for Calispel Valley & Ione Libraries Remodel
short_description: Architectural and engineering services for remodeling two existing libraries in Washington.
project_scope: Remodel of two existing library buildings for the Pend Oreille County Library District in Cusick and Ione, Washington. The notice does not provide gross floor areas, structural interventions, or technical parameters. Scope includes development of construction documents, construction administration, and project closeout for both library remodel projects.
services: Basic architectural and engineering services, including architecture, civil engineering, structural engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, fire protection engineering, construction administration, and project closeout activities.
relevance_explanation:
- Building remodel of two small public libraries with no stated large spans or special structural features.
- Primarily an architectural and general engineering assignment rather than a structurally driven or innovative lightweight structure.
- Includes structural engineering, which gives some relevance.
- Public building work can be of interest, but this project appears small and technically ordinary based on the notice.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. Available information for an estimate is limited to the fact that two existing libraries in Cusick and Ione, Washington will be remodeled; no areas, program, or level of intervention are provided, so no realistic estimate can be derived.
fee_explanation: No design fee or fee basis is stated in the notice. The procurement covers basic architectural and engineering services through construction documents, construction administration, and closeout, but there is insufficient cost and scope detail for a reliable fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Not specified in the notice. Disciplines requested are architecture, civil engineering, structural engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, fire protection engineering, and construction/project management.
